events.body:
## Context

This is the first page newcomers see, and its setup commands fail: `public/index.html` (about L292-306) says `cd BLT` (the monorepo root has no `manage.py`) and `pip install -r requirements.txt` (blt-core has no requirements.txt; it uses uv). The "Creating a Merge Request" steps use an `upstream` remote that is never added.

## What to do

1. Use `cd BLT/blt-core` and the uv commands from `blt-core/README.md` Quick start.
2. Relabel the BLT-Core repo link (about L254) to "BLT/BLT-Core".
3. Add `git remote add upstream https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git` before it's used.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commands match blt-core's README
- [ ] No `requirements.txt` or bare `cd BLT`
- [ ] `upstream` defined before use

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-start/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
Size: **S** · good first issue. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
